text:
Ava Li: hey team, heads-up — my flight got moved to sunday evening. I need someone to cover the 8pm->midnight oncall window (PST) this weekend. I can swap with someone earlier in the day if that works.

Jon Park: I can take the 8pm->midnight slot if that helps. I'll need a quick handoff note for anything currently flaky.

Ava Li: awesome thanks @Jon. quick notes below — copying the minimal checklist so it's easy to skim: 
- Alerts: we've been seeing recurring `nvme_high_util` warnings on embeddings-1 (nodes e-emb-{2,3}). They've been noisy but not full outages. Sam restarted the affected pod yesterday (see #oncall-logs).
- Scheduled jobs: a small canary rollout for `redwood-runtime` (v3.2.1) is scheduled sunday 23:00 PST from product. It's low-risk but follow the rollout dashboard and rollback if latency > 250ms p50. 
- Open PRs to watch: PR #842 (kv-cache eviction fix) — merged to canary yesterday but still watching perf. PR #856 is blocked by infra.
- Playbook quick commands: if the embeddings workers are OOMing, check pods with `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=embeddings` and restart with `kubectl delete pod <pod>`; for a graceful runtime restart: 
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/redwood-runtime -n inference
```
- Escalation: pager -> primary oncall -> Sam B. (pager) -> Eng SRE rotation. If customer impact (>=3 users degraded) ping @Priya.

Jon Park: got it. couple clarifying q's — what threshold did we set for rollback on canary? you mentioned 250ms p50 but our alert is p95 350ms last I checked.

Ava Li: yeah product asked for p50 250ms as the soft gate for the canary; but platform SLOs are p95 350ms. If p95 goes above 350ms during rollout, rollback immediately. If only p50 drifts between 250-300ms, open a note but let the canary run and monitor for 15m.

Priya Nair: thanks for the notes — can you also add the customer-facing ticket IDs that might be affected? I can triage if anything pops.

Ava Li: sure — CF tickets: CF-4231 (enterprise embeddings slowness), CF-4250 (one-off timeouts for synth test). I left a quick summary in both tickets.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window sunday 22:00-23:30 PST (infra team). This may overlap with the canary rollout. Please coordinate.

Ava Li: oh right — the infra window is why I wanted someone later in the evening. if infra starts their storage maintenance and we see `nvme_high_util` spikes, prioritize stopping the canary and opening an incident if error rates > 1%.

Sam B.: FYI I've left sticky notes in the runbook about the nvme symptoms (paths and log grep). Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (internal).

Jon Park: ok I'm taking it. I'll add myself to the calendar and set reminders + watch the canary dashboard. Ava, enjoy your trip :wave:

Ava Li: thanks @Jon — I moved my shifts in the rota and updated the handoff doc. if anything urgent ping my mobile. :thumbsup:

Jon Park: added a short checklist to the calendar event and set a Slack reminder for 22:50 PST to re-check canary status.

Priya Nair: thanks both — I'll be monitoring support queue on sunday evening in case any customers surface issues.

Ava Li: appreciated. last tiny note: if you need to clear the embeddings node cache quickly, this helper command has been useful: `curl -X POST "http://embeddings-admin:8080/cache/clear?node=e-emb-2"` — only run if logs show repeated `kv_eviction` entries.

Jon Park: good to know. see you all sunday night (on duty). :eyes:
